Ready for More?

Barbell Overhead Press: Increase load gradually while keeping balance and trunk control. Dumbbell Overhead Press: Add small load increments while keeping the trunk steady and path controlled.

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift / Barbell Romanian Deadlift

HingeDumbbellsIntermediate

Strengthen the hips, hamstrings, and back through a hip-hinge pattern.

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift · BFIT-00099 ↗
Barbell Romanian Deadlift · BFIT-00100 ↗

Use your workout’s sets, repetitions, and time. These are distinct variations; choose the one named in your plan. The linked library has current instructions; downloaded guides are snapshots.

Instructions & options
How to Perform

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift: Stand with your feet at a comfortable hip-width stance and hold the dumbbells near your thighs. Soften your knees, then send your hips backward while keeping the weights close to your legs. Stop before you need to round or strain to go lower. Push through your feet and bring your hips forward to stand tall.

Barbell Romanian Deadlift: Hold a barbell near the thighs with softly bent knees. Send the hips backward while keeping the bar close; stop at a controllable range, then stand.

Key Coaching Cues

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift: Stop where you can maintain control; reaching the floor is unnecessary. Avoid turning the movement into a deep squat.

Barbell Romanian Deadlift: Keep the movement at the hips; touching the floor is not required.

Common Mistakes

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift: Rounding the lower back, squatting the movement, or lowering farther than hip mobility permits. Barbell Romanian Deadlift: Letting the bar drift forward or rounding the back to reach a lower position.

Need an Easier Option?

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift: Practice a bodyweight hip hinge or use lighter dumbbells with a shorter lowering distance. Barbell Romanian Deadlift: Use an unloaded/light bar, shorten the lowering range, and practice a hip hinge.

Ready for More?

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift: Increase load slightly while keeping the weights close and maintaining the hinge. Barbell Romanian Deadlift: Increase load gradually without losing a controlled hip hinge or bar proximity.

T

Inverted Table Row / Anchored Towel Row

Horizontal PullTable or TowelBeginner

Strengthen the upper back and pulling muscles.

Inverted Table Row · BFIT-00119 ↗
Anchored Towel Row · BFIT-00120 ↗

Use your workout’s sets, repetitions, and time. These are distinct variations; choose the one named in your plan. The linked library has current instructions; downloaded guides are snapshots.

Instructions & options
How to Perform

Inverted Table Row: Only use a structure confirmed suitable to support your bodyweight without tipping or sliding. Grip the edge from underneath with feet grounded, pull the chest toward it, then lower.

Anchored Towel Row: Use an undamaged towel and an anchor specifically suitable to support your bodyweight. Hold the ends, lean back with feet grounded, pull your torso toward the anchor, then lower.

Key Coaching Cues

Inverted Table Row: If the structure or grip is uncertain, use purpose-built row equipment or another pulling exercise.

Anchored Towel Row: Do not rely on an unverified door handle or household fixture; choose another row if the anchor cannot be confirmed.

Common Mistakes

Inverted Table Row: Using an unstable table, allowing the hips to sag, or pulling suddenly on the support. Anchored Towel Row: Anchoring a towel to an unsecured door or handle, or leaning back farther than the anchor can support.

Need an Easier Option?

Inverted Table Row: Do not use furniture unless it is purpose-built and verified secure; use a stable gym suspension trainer or supported dumbbell row instead. Anchored Towel Row: Use a purpose-built, load-rated anchor and stand more upright; otherwise substitute a supported dumbbell or cable row.

Ready for More?

Inverted Table Row: Move feet slightly forward on a secure rated setup to increase the challenge while keeping the body straight. Anchored Towel Row: Step farther from a certified fixed anchor only after confirming it is secure and form is controlled.
